sections.heading: About Nahtivo
sections.body: Nahtivo is a platform that connects tourists with local guides certified by Nahtivo in the Ahuachapán department of El Salvador. By using this site or submitting a booking or subscription form, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: How bookings work
sections.body: When you complete the booking form, you're sending a request, not an automatic confirmation. The guide or the Nahtivo team will reach out (by email, phone, or WhatsApp) to confirm availability and arrange payment. For now, payment is coordinated directly with the guide and is not processed through the site.

sections.heading: Cancellations and changes
sections.body: Cancellation policies may vary by guide and experience. We'll confirm them with you when coordinating your booking.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: Experiences are led by local guides certified by Nahtivo, but every activity carries the risks inherent to outdoor tourism. Always follow your guide's instructions.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about these terms, message us on WhatsApp using the contact button on the site.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: When you book an experience or subscribe, we store your name, email, phone number, and the details of your request (date, number of people, notes, or your interest in the case of subscriptions).

sections.heading: What we use it for
sections.body: We use this data only to confirm your booking or subscription and to get in touch with you. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Where it's stored
sections.body: Your data is stored in a secure database (Supabase), accessible only to the Nahtivo team through a password-protected account.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us at any time to show you, correct, or delete your data by messaging us on WhatsApp using the contact button on the site.
